raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"Make your way straight ahead to your final stop.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Trocadéro's palace rose for a world fair; this hall began as a tennis court.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Stand in front of the Galerie nationale du Jeu de Paume, and the name is a clue — it's a gallery now, but it began as a tennis court.","source_id":"9a994390-5c16-4921-982d-e078b2f0ec71","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Napoleon III had it built in 1861 for the jeu de paume, the indoor game the building is named after, and it was enlarged in 1878.","source_id":"9a994390-5c16-4921-982d-e078b2f0ec71","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Three different lives, all under one roof.","source_id":"9a994390-5c16-4921-982d-e078b2f0ec71","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"That's the walk — a tennis court that grew into a gallery.","source_id":"GLUE_CLOSING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1}]}
